title: Sequenced outreach — LivingSpring Health (play notes)
content:
Quick note: spin up cadence for LivingSpring Health — midsize telehealth provider (primary care + chronic-care management). Primary hypothesis: they care about latency for note-generation + data residency for PHI, and cost predictability for per-encounter NLP features.

Snapshot (what I can find quickly):
- HQ: Denver, ~2100 employees, Series D (2023).
- Product: telemedicine platform + integrated chronic care programs, heavy clinician note workflows and post-visit summarization.
- Tech hints: using mix of AWS + some on-prem remote clinics (mentions ‘private network’ in SEC filing). Likely constrained by HITRUST requirements.
- Recent signals: job postings for ML infra engineer (Jan 2025), blog post about automating care-plan generation (Aug 2024).

Primary personas to target (mapped to Redwood value):
- VP of Platform / Head of SRE — cares about reliability, SLOs, private deployment, observability (Console).
- Director of Clinical Informatics / ML Lead — cares about quality/regulatory, evals, model control (canary/rollouts).
- Product Manager (Care Coordination) — cares about latency, per-encounter cost, UX of summarization.
- Security/Privacy Officer — cares about KMS, audit logs, VPC, HITRUST evidence.

Key pain hypotheses (to validate in discovery):
- Tokenized note generation is expensive at scale; budget unpredictability.
- Latency spikes harm clinician workflow; need sub-second for autocompletion/autosuggest.
- Compliance/regulatory (PHI) requires private deployment or strong data isolation.
- Multi-clinic topology -> need routing by region and fallback across capacity.

Value props to call out (short):
- Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) + audit logs for PHI compliance.
- Predictable Dedicated capacity for per-encounter throughput and cost smoothing.
- Optimize toolkit: batching + prefix caching to reduce token costs for templated notes.
- Console: token-level cost breakdown + rollouts for clinical quality regression guardrails.

Early outreach plan (2-week micro-experiment):
- Step 0 (prep): gather 2-3 anonymized examples of current note length distribution (avg tokens/visit). MVP ask: a single CSV with tokens-per-note to estimate cost.
- Step 1 (email -> PM/ML lead): short problem framing + 2-sentence value claim + CTA for 20-min technical sync.
- Step 2 (LinkedIn touch to Director of Clinical Informatics): mention mutual contact (if found) and quick stat (avg tokens reduction via caching).
- Step 3 (follow-up email + one-pager attached): sample cost model for 10k visits/month (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- Step 4 (if interest): offer a 2-week pilot on Dedicated capacity with guardrails (cost cap + fallback model).

Email drafts (short, use as templates):
- Cold intro to ML Lead (subject: "Reduce note-gen costs while keeping clinician latency"):
Hi [Name],
I noticed LivingSpring recently published on automating care plans — congrats. We help teams reduce per-visit LLM costs and avoid latency regressions by combining predictable Dedicated capacity and caching + autoscaling policies.
Quick thought: with a small pilot (10k visits/mo) we can show ~30–45% token cost reduction (prefix caching + batching) without impacting latency.
Are you open to a 20-min call next week to see a concrete cost/latency sketch?
Cheers,
Aisha

- Follow-up (if no reply):
Subject: "Short model: cost/latency sketch for LivingSpring"
Hey [Name],
Two quick links: (1) rough cost example for 10k visits (attached) (2) a brief note on our private deployment options for PHI. If you can spare 15m, I’ll walk through numbers.

LinkedIn script (intro message):
Hi [Name] — saw your post about automating care plans. I work at Redwood Inference; we’ve helped similar telehealth teams reduce token spend and keep clinician-facing latency predictable. Would love to share a one-pager.

Discovery question checklist (rough):
- How many visits/month are you instrumenting for summarization? Average tokens per note?
- What is the current latency target for in-UI suggestions or final note generation? (target and 95th pct)
- Are notes processed in-host (VPC/on-prem) today? Any regulatory constraints (HITRUST, SOC2, state regs)?
- Who owns ML infra vs platform vs compliance? Decision-maker map?
- Any hard cost targets per encounter?
- What are your rollout/fallback expectations if a model version regresses in quality?

Objection handling crib (bullety, short):
- "We run everything in-house / already have a model": Great — ask: what’s current ops cost + effort? Offer a hybrid: bring our serving runtime into your VPC (license + infra runbook) and keep model control.
- "Security / PHI concerns": We have private deployment + HSM/KMS integrations and audit logs. Offer to share redacted compliance checklist and architecture diagram.
- "We need guarantees on latency": Propose Dedicated capacity with latency SLOs and canary rollouts + automatic fallback to faster model variant.
- "Cost — not budgeted": Start with a short proof-of-value pilot on a small traffic slice with cost cap + measurement; show concrete before/after.

Technical quicknotes (for sync / to share with eng):
- Ask for token distribution (token histogram) + typical input prompts used for summarization (templates).
- Discuss KV cache strategy: we can cache common prefixes like SOAP template headers to cut repeated tokens.
- Propose metrics to monitor: tokens/visit, avg latency (p50/p95), model-quality regression rate (evaluations on static prompt set).
- Integration options: REST API (hosted) -> quick; Dedicated private endpoints (VPC peering) -> for HIPAA PHI; on-prem package if clinics are air-gapped.

Experiment success criteria (for our team):
- Book 1 technical discovery with ML infra + product within 3 weeks.
- Get token histogram or sample data to model costs.
- If pilot runs: demonstrate >=20% reduction in token spend OR keep costs flat while improving 95th latency.

Notes to self / follow-ups: 
- Reach out to Marco for compliance one-pager + app architecture diagram (JIRA GT-4128).
- Devon to draft cost model spreadsheet template (use 3 scenarios: hosted, dedicated, private) — ask for avg tokens/visit input.
- Look for mutual connections on LinkedIn: check employees from 'engineering' + clinical informatics.
- Prepare short redacted case study of similar telehealth customer (if exists) — if not, prepare synthetic example.

Unresolved / unknowns (list):
- Exact compliance regime (HITRUST? state-level PHI?). Need to confirm in discovery.
- Are there legacy on-prem clinics that cannot route traffic to cloud? If yes, on-prem package details needed.
- Who signs the pilot contract (legal) — internal procurement timeline varies.

Tone notes: keep outreach low-friction, number-driven. Avoid product pitch — lead with cost/latency numbers and compliance reassurance.

Next steps (today):
1) Send cold intro to 2 targets (ML Lead + Platform VP).
2) DM Director Clinical Informatics on LinkedIn.
3) Pull cost template + compliance one-pager to attach.

---
Riff lines (brainstorm / short bullets):
- "Pilot: 2 weeks on Dedicated w/ cost cap + auto-fallback" — keeps executive buy-in low friction.
- "We’ll instrument 50k tokens/day and measure 2-week baseline vs optimized" — concrete metric.
- "If successful, handoff to platform team for Dedicated subscription" — natural GTM conversion.

End of scratch — keep quick notes here as I iterate.

TODO (checkboxes, not formal):

- [ ] Ask Marco for compliance doc
- [ ] Populate cost model with sample tokens/visit once we get data
- [ ] Book initial tech sync if reply
